SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_BOX_LUNCH.title: Box Lunch
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_BOX_LUNCH.descrip:
The first time a [gold]Script[/gold] ends each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Script: Sentry[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_BOX_LUNCH.flavor: What do we eat when the lunch boxes are gone?
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_ABUNDANT_BOX_LUNC:
The first three times a [gold]Script[/gold] ends each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Script: Vice General[/gold].
Upgraded lunch. Still a lunch box.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_MENGDE_NEW_BOOK.d:
For each [blue]Buff[/blue] an enemy has, the damage it deals to you is reduced by [blue]10%[/blue].
For each [blue]Debuff[/blue] you have, damage you deal is increased by [blue]10%[/blue].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_MENGDE_NEW_BOOK.f: War is the way of deception.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_ADVANCED_GUNPOWDE:
At the start of each combat, gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Fuel Abundant[/gold].
Whenever you apply [gold]Burning[/gold], reduce its clear chance to [blue]0%[/blue] instead of [blue]25%[/blue].
Firepower is the best line reading.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_ZHU_DICTIONARY.de: Whenever you obtain a [gold]Script[/gold] card, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_TELEPROMPTER.flav: Forget your lines? Not on my watch.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_SUPPORTING_ACTOR_:
After combats from the strong monster pool, gain a Relic as if from an Elite.
After the second-to-last Boss combat in Act 3, gain an upgraded Rare card reward.
